import socket

def main():
	host = '127.0.0.1'  # IP of the Godot server
	port = 12345        # Port to match Godot

	s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
	s.connect((host, port))

	print("Connected to server. (Press Ctrl+C to stop)")
	
	# Hard-coded positions to send
	positions = [
		(100, 200),
		(300, 400),
		(500, 300),
		(200, 500)
	]
	
	try:
		for x, y in positions:
			input(f"Press Enter to send position ({x},{y})...")
			message = f"{x},{y}"
			s.sendall(message.encode())
			print(f"Sent: {message}")
			
		print("All positions sent. Press Enter to exit...")
		input()
	except KeyboardInterrupt:
		print("Stopping...")
	finally:
		s.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
	main()
